topics.title: BPD: definition, causes and explanatory models
topics.scope: What borderline personality disorder is (core instability), the DBT biosocial and psychoanalytic models, brain findings on impulsivity, stigma history, short answers to common BPD questions, and 'quiet BPD' with its 21-sign checklist and self-questions.

topics.title: BPD in relationships: rejection sensitivity, mentalization and loneliness
topics.scope: Interpersonal hypersensitivity and rejection sensitivity in BPD and ADHD, mentalization and empathy research, loneliness and smaller social networks, and the 'favorite person' attachment with splitting, burnout of FP relationships and what can change.

topics.title: Self-image, identity and emptiness in BPD
topics.scope: Disturbed sense of self as a proposed core of BPD, chronic emptiness, low unstable self-esteem, why a calm life feels unbearable, self-perception across disorders, and how a sense of 'I' forms and can be deliberately built (building blocks of self-awareness, brain basis, practical strategies).

topics.title: Suicidal thinking and self-harm
topics.scope: Suicide myths and prevention, passive versus active suicidal ideation and warning signs, suicidal thoughts as an escape habit, and research on what predicts and precedes self-harm in BPD.

topics.title: Crisis survival skills: STOP, TIPP and distraction
topics.scope: DBT distress-tolerance skills for peak emotions: the STOP skill, cold-water dive reflex, intense exercise, paced breathing and muscle relaxation, the distraction acronym, and steps out of helplessness.

topics.title: Mindfulness in DBT: WHAT skills, non-judgment and urge surfing
topics.scope: Why mindfulness matters in DBT, the observe/describe/participate and non-judgmental skills, effectiveness, urge surfing for cravings, odd sensations in meditation and criticisms of mindfulness.

topics.title: Radical acceptance and validation
topics.scope: The DBT radical acceptance skill with reflection questions, the six levels of validation for supporting loved ones, and combining acceptance, mindfulness and self-compassion when life is hard.

topics.title: Lowering emotional vulnerability: routines, food and boring basics
topics.scope: PLEASE-style care of the body to reduce emotional vulnerability, foods linked to mood swings, building a daily routine with BPD, self-care after shocking events, and why evidence-based basics beat magic fixes.

topics.title: Recognizing PTSD and complex PTSD
topics.scope: Normal trauma reactions versus PTSD, PTSD versus cPTSD (history, ICD-11 picture, causes, a ten-question Q&A, therapy routes such as DBT skills plus prolonged exposure), traumatic invalidation, the threat-response cascade, medical PTSD and links to chronic pain.

topics.title: Coping with trauma, ongoing threat and post-traumatic growth
topics.scope: Coping strategies that lower PTSD risk, supporting a loved one after trauma, post-traumatic growth, living and working amid ongoing threat, and how distressing news and doomscrolling affect the psyche, with an information diet and urge surfing.

topics.title: Dissociation, depersonalization and out-of-body experiences
topics.scope: What dissociation is, depersonalization versus derealization, out-of-body experiences and cPTSD, dissociation as avoidance in BPD, and grounding techniques such as 5-4-3-2-1.

topics.title: Neurobiology of trauma and trauma memory
topics.scope: How trauma affects memory (hippocampus, amygdala, fragmentation), the cerebellar vermis and freezing, and the opioid and endocannabinoid systems in PTSD, dissociation and fear extinction.

topics.title: How religions and spiritual traditions made sense of trauma
topics.scope: How Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism and shamanic traditions interpreted traumatic suffering (punishment, test, karma, soul loss), practices such as tonglen, and how these ideas prefigure modern trauma therapy.

topics.title: Understanding emotions and emotional dysregulation
topics.scope: What emotional dysregulation is and its warning signs, emotions as a smoke detector, constructed emotions, frustrative non-reward and anger, changing emotions indirectly, and why emotions cost energy.

topics.title: Avoidance, rumination, anxiety and exposure
topics.scope: Why escaping strong emotions backfires, five types of emotional avoidance, rumination and its pleasant relatives, recognizing anxiety, exposure therapy via inhibitory learning, and generalized anxiety disorder with its four-factor model (intolerance of uncertainty, worry as cognitive avoidance).

topics.title: Self-criticism, people-pleasing and social comparison
topics.scope: How self-criticism harms and techniques to soften the inner critic, roots of people-pleasing in cPTSD and BPD, and why others' good news stings through upward social comparison.

topics.title: Differential diagnosis and classification: BPD, bipolar, cPTSD and HiTOP
topics.scope: Telling BPD apart from bipolar disorder and cPTSD, common comorbidities, BPD as a trauma-spectrum disorder, HiTOP versus DSM/ICD, and what to expect from a psychiatrist appointment.

topics.title: Depression, seasonal depression and grief
topics.scope: Seasonal affective disorder and its treatments (light, vitamin D), non-obvious depression symptoms, stages of grief and the neurobiology of prolonged grief.

topics.title: Bipolar disorder: routines, caffeine and pregnancy
topics.scope: Social rhythm therapy (IPSRT) for stabilizing routines in bipolar disorder, caffeine and mania risk, medication and therapy in pregnancy, and emotion dysregulation in bipolar disorder compared with depression and BPD.

topics.title: Antisocial personality disorder: signs, myths and therapy
topics.scope: Diagnostic signs of antisocial personality disorder, how it presents in women, myths about psychopathy and sociopathy, and how DBT and MBT work with it.

topics.title: PTSD nightmares and sleep disturbances
topics.scope: How trauma disrupts sleep, ordinary versus cPTSD nightmares, the neurobiology of the two nightmare scenarios, REM and sleep architecture in PTSD, treatments (IRT, CBT-I, lucid dream therapy) and sleep hygiene.

topics.title: Procrastination, motivation and the vacation brain
topics.scope: Analyzing a procrastination episode for its function and alternatives, self-determination theory and why intentions stall, and what rest and novelty on vacation do to stress, attention and wants.
